label: mid-original-phase steps after early t/2, in sequences starting n/e/x (diffuse conjunction)
explanation: Sparse feature (0.07% of steps), almost entirely in the original-input phase at positions 3-6 (99% of mass). It never fires at t=0-1 and is nearly silent in the copy phase. Activation is raised by several soft factors that stack: the first token is n (14.5x lift, 49% of mass), e or x; t or 2 appears early in the sequence (prev2_tok=t gives 12.5x); and the current input is g/y/b/n/f/e. Top examples look like n t t [g] or n t 2 [g]. No single clean predicate fits. Even the best conjunction reaches only F1 ~0.25 on dev (precision 0.20, mass recall 0.35), and simpler versions such as early t/2 alone have precision near 1%. Magnitude is highest when all the factors line up, but beyond the top examples this was not checked quantitatively. It looks like a direction in hidden-state space that mixes token identities, not a single interpretable condition.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=n (+6.34), orig2=t (+4.49), orig0=e (+4.41), orig0=x (+4.22), orig2=2 (+3.26), orig0=q (+2.88). Lower it: prev2_tok=- (-4.65), orig_idx=-1 (-4.21), prev_tok=o (-3.96), in_tok=c (-3.71).
